Guidance and Control Engineer The Vydar Group 
Other Engineering 
 Posted on Aug 28, 2026 
 Apply now 
 As a Guidance and Control Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and scaling Vydar's next-generation defence technology. You will work closely with our founding team and technical partners to bring our solutions from lab to field deployment.You will develop guidance and control software for constrained hardware and AI edge computing devices used in defense applications. This includes systems for missile platforms, UAVs, drones, and distributed sensing networks. Building NPU based navigation software for electromagnetic contested environments (no GPS) or interception.You will join a team of 7 to 10 highly skilled engineers with backgrounds in aerospace, microelectronics, embedded hardware and software, and machine vision. Flyer Delivery Driver - Amsterdam - € 16,19 per uur - 2 - 4 uur, 1 - 4 dagen per week - Geen 
Doing a job right in your own neighborhood where you can have friendly chats with the locals? How great is that?!✨✨ You can make it happen as a flyer delivery driver at Spotta in Amsterdam! This job takes about 2 to a maximum of 4 hours per week. You don't have to travel, and you are truly flexible in deciding when you deliver the flyers. On top of that, you earn €16.19 per hour (incl. holiday pay)!Curious to learn more? Read on below! 
 what we offer 
 A great wage of €16.19 per hour! 
 Healthy: stay physically active in the fresh air! 
 Work in your own neighborhood-zero commute time! 
 A flexible job-you choose when you deliver! 
 Hit the road fully equipped with handy Spotta bags 
 who you are 
As a flyer delivery driver at Spotta in Amsterdam, it is important that you can work independently. You are also responsible and reliable-ensuring the flyers are always delivered neatly and on time. Furthermore, you: - Live in the postal code area 1051 until 1059 + 1071 until 1083 in Amsterdam; - Are available to work 2 to a maximum of 4 hours per week; - Are able to deliver the flyers on Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, or Monday (you choose when); - Are physically capable of lifting flyer bundles and walking or cycling; - Speak Dutch or English; - Are comfortable receiving the flyer delivery packages at your home; - Own a bicycle with a rear luggage rack (required for the panniers). 
 what will you do 
As a flyer delivery driver at Spotta, you will deliver flyer bundles in a neighborhood. On Thursday, Friday, or Saturday, the flyers you need to deliver will be dropped off at your house. You don't have to stay home for this, but it is important that the packages remain secure. You have until Monday at 7:00 PM to finish your deliveries. Ideal, because you can schedule it exactly around your availability (and keep an eye on the weather forecast!...

Are you looking for an IT opportunity within an international environment? Then look no further, Super Micro is looking for you!

As a Rework Technician you are responsible for:

- Perform tests and rework for PCBA products and documents, including motherboards, backplanes, and AOCs.
- Enter data and give feedback on defects to the quality team.
- Follow standard testing procedures and schedules to meet daily demands and quality standards.
- Work efficiently in a fast-paced production environment and follow company and production policies.
- Perform ECO, BIOS, and FW upgrades, as well as other tasks assigned by the supervisor.

What do we offer?
In addition to an attractive salary starting at €2,650 gross per month, we offer:

- Weekly salary payments.
- 8 Vacation allowance and 25 vacation days (full-time).
- Travel allowance of 0.23 per kilometer.
- Participation in the pension fund from day one.

Super Micro is a market leader in the latest IT solutions, such as servers and systems for data storage. During breaks, you can use the canteen, where you can also enjoy a free cup of coffee or a nice hot cup of tea. With a bus stop nearby, Super Micro is also easy to reach by public transport.

What do we ask?
- Relevant work experience OR education in computer/electronics
- Basic English communication skills (reading, speaking, writing, B1)

- Strong attention to detail
- Strong interest in computers/electronics

The cleanroom is a highly controlled, sterile environment designed to minimize – and ideally eliminate – contamination during production or research processes. Contaminants can include dust, fibers, airborne microorganisms, fine particles, or chemical vapors. You’ll be responsible for cleaning metal frames and components that are used in industries such as microchip manufacturing. Together with your colleagues, you will also clean all related packaging materials to ensure they meet the highest cleanliness standards required for use in cleanroom environments.

In this position you work in a production environment. Of course you also check the products. In addition, your daily work as a Cleanroom Operator consists of:

- Cleaning high-tech (technical parts) parts according to instructions and protocols
- Carrying out assembly and cleaning work
- Carrying out quality measurements
- Working on the basis of instructions and drawings (Powerpoint)

To be successful in this position, you preferably already have some technical insight / technical experience in a Cleanroom or any other production environment.

You bring commitment and enthusiasm to your work and identify with the following qualities:

- Positive mindset
- Stress-resistant and responsible
- Proactive and involved team player
- Helpful, quality-focused, and safety-oriented

Additionally, you:

- Have a good command of the English language, as all safety protocols, work instructions, and team communication are in English
- Work in a structured and independent manner
- Can read technical drawings and follow detailed work instructions accurately
- Living in the area of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven or Valkenswaard

As a production worker, you’ll be part of a lively team of over 30 colleagues in a modern production facility. Working in a 2-shift system, you’ll help oversee the entire production process — from raw materials to finished products. We produce a wide variety of peanut butter for a diverse customer base, so no two days are the same.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Operating and setting up production machines

- Troubleshooting minor technical issues

- Performing routine maintenance on equipment

- Checking finished products for quality and consistency

We do not provide accommodations. You need to live in the surroundings of Raamsdonkveer.

You will work in 2 shifts from 6:00 to 14:15 and from 14:00 to 22:15.

Requirements for working as a production worker:

- You’ve already worked in a production environment

- You know how to solve little technical issues on the production line

- Willingness to work in a production environment (including exposure to food products)

- Basic understanding of English or Dutch

- Willingness to help your co-workers on the production line

You work in a cleanroom and/or warehouse and ensure products are processed correctly and safely.

- Work according to strict cleanroom procedures and hygiene rules
- Clean and assemble high-tech components
- Perform quality checks on products
- Register materials in the system (WMS)
- Pack and prepare products for shipment
- Load and unload incoming and outgoing goods
- Work together with colleagues from logistics and production

Working hours (2-shifts):

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 15:00 – 24:00
You receive a 18% shift allowance on all hours worked.

- Minimum 1 year experience in cleanroom, production, or logistics
- Good command of the English language (reading and speaking)
- Willing to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Able to work accurately following clear instructions
- Forklift certificate is a plus (or willing to obtain one)

You will work for a growing food production company specializing in preserved food products packaged in stand-up pouches and jars. Quality, safety, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.
As a Production Worker, you will be part of a dynamic team operating in a 3-shift system. You will support the production process and ensure that all operations run smoothly and efficiently.

- Assist the machine operator during production processes
- Perform physical tasks, including frequent lifting
- Support colleagues where needed to maintain workflow
- Ensure a clean and safe working environment
- Follow hygiene and safety regulations at all times

Requirements

- You speak and understand English or Dutch
- You have your own transportation
- You live within a 20 km radius of Nieuwkuijk
- You are able to perform manual work
- You are flexible and willing to work in a 3-shift system

As a Cleanroom Foil Employee, you will work in a clean production environment where high-tech components are packaged and protected for international transport. You will work accurately based on technical drawings and work instructions.

Your tasks include:

- Cutting foil using production machines for high-tech packaging
- Packaging fragile components for air transport
- Cleaning and packing products and components
- Assembling packaging materials according to instructions
- Working according to cleanroom rules and safety procedures
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Keeping the workplace and cleanroom environment clean and organized

You will work in a 2-shift schedule with the following working hours:

- Week 1: Monday to Friday from 06:00 – 15:00
- Week 2: Monday to Friday from 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- Experience as an assembly or production employee is a plus
- Technical insight and interest in production processes
- Ability to read technical drawings and work instructions
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Good command of the English language
- Accurate and quality-focused work attitude
- Living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard region is a plus

You will ensure the printing process runs smoothly, from loading paper rolls to performing maintenance. You will oversee the entire process from start to finish, making you responsible for the final product!

What will you do?

- Prepare and manage paper supply
- Manage paper and ink inventory
- Set up and operate the printing machine
- Oversee the printing process, including post-production
- Perform general maintenance
- Develop and maintain the production schedule

- You speak either Dutch or English fluently
- You live near Etten-Leur (within a 30 km radius)

Do you have experience as a supervisor? Are you looking for a responsible job? Are you able to optimize day-to-day activities while minimizing costs? Then we are looking for you!

What are you going to do?
- Organize workflow by assigning responsibilities and preparing schedules
- Responsible for scheduling control
- Maintain material control and quality control
- Responsible for other duties on assembly line
- Oversee and coach employees
- Identify issues in efficiency and suggest improvements
- Enforce strict safety guidelines and company standards.

What do we offer?
In addition to a competitive and negotiable salary, we offer:

- weekly payment of this salary,
- 8% holiday allowance and 25 days of leave (on a full-time basis),
- participation in the pension scheme from day 1, and
- personal development. During your contract you have access to the Adecco Academy, an online platform with various training and courses.

Where will you work?
Our client is an employer that offers equal opportunities for everyone and embraces diversity in the employee population. Our client is a world leader in IT products. The servers are built in Den Bosch, where they have their own production department.

You often work together with (international) colleagues. They communicate with each other in English or Dutch.

What do we ask?
- High School degree, college degree preferred
- Minimum 5+ years of relative working experience in electronic or computer industry preferred
- Solid understanding of computer system assembly
- Possess basic mechanical knowledge
- Familiarity with computer or electronic components testing and inspection
- Experience with mechanical assembly, cable routing, and quality standards
- Strong attention to detail, including accuracy and thoroughness
- Ability to comprehend spoken and written English

As an Assembly & Repair Technician, you work in a modern production environment. Together with 6 to 8 colleagues per shift, you make sure technical parts are assembled, checked and prepared for shipment.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling technical parts according to drawings and work instructions
- Repairing and checking plastic, metal and wooden parts
- Packing fragile parts in large crates for international transport
- Carrying out quality checks during and after the work
- Working with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- Reporting defects or deviations to your supervisor
- Keeping your workplace clean and safe

You work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 to 15:00
- Afternoon/evening shift: 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- For this role, we ask:- You are available full-time for a 2-shift schedule
- You live in the Eindhoven, Veldhoven, Best or Helmond region
- You have experience in technical work, assembly or repair
- You can work with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- You can read technical drawings and follow work instructions
- You have a good command of English, both spoken and written

As a demolition worker, you are responsible for carrying out demolition and clean-up activities safely and efficiently. Experience is not required; motivation and a practical attitude are most important.

Your tasks include:

- Demolishing walls, floors and other constructions using hand tools and small machinery
- Cleaning and removing debris from demolition sites
- Separating construction waste and materials according to safety regulations
- Assisting colleagues during renovation and demolition projects
- Loading and unloading materials and tools
- Following VGM and safety instructions on-site
- Keeping the workplace clean and organised

You work in a 2-shift schedule:

- Early shift: Monday to Friday from 06:00 to 15:00
- Late shift: Monday to Friday from 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance on top of your salary.

For this position, it is important that you enjoy physical work and can work safely on construction and demolition sites.

We ask the following:

- You have an active and practical working attitude
- You are physically fit and able to perform heavy work
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift schedule
- You understand basic safety and VGM instructions
- You can work both independently and in a team
- A driver's license B is an advantage
- You have a good command of the English language

Do you enjoy taking control and ensuring everything runs smoothly? As a Print Production Worker, you'll be responsible for delivering print materials in perfect condition to our clients. From bundling and packing to cutting and folding, you'll tackle the work with enthusiasm.

Responsibilities:

- Bundling and packing print materials
- Cutting flyers, brochures, and folders
- Creating stapled brochures
- Folding various types of folders

- Good command of the English language
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team
- Living in the Etten-Leur area
- Own transport
- Available to work in 3shift system

As a Logistics Employee, you will work within a logistics team in Eindhoven and be responsible for processing incoming and outgoing goods. You maintain an overview, work accurately, and help ensure a smooth logistics process together with your colleagues.

Your tasks include:

- Working in a 2-shift schedule from 06:00 – 15:00 and 15:00 – 00:00
- Scanning, sorting, and labeling goods
- Collecting and preparing orders for shipment
- Loading and unloading trucks using an EPT or forklift
- Moving goods within the warehouse and production environment
- Processing logistics data in the warehouse management system
- Checking goods for quantities and quality

You will receive a shift allowance for working in shifts according to the applicable employment conditions.

- Good command of the English language
- Physically fit and comfortable with physical work
- Available to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Willing to occasionally work on Saturday mornings
- Accurate working attitude and able to work independently and in a team

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with an EPT or forklift
- A valid forklift or EPT certificate, or willingness to obtain one through WerkTalent
- Living in the Eindhoven region or willing to travel

As a logistics employee, you play an important role in the warehouse and distribution process. You make sure goods are handled safely, correctly and on time.

Your tasks are:

- Loading and unloading trucks.
- Packing, sorting and labelling products.
- Preparing orders and processing returns.
- Checking the quality and quantity of goods.
- Registering your work in the system.
- Solving small deviations and keeping the warehouse tidy.
- Moving goods with an EPT and sometimes with a forklift.

You work from Monday to Friday in 2 shifts. One week you work from 06:00 to 15:00. The other week you work from 15:00 to 00:00.

- You speak and understand English.
- You have experience in logistics.
- You enjoy working in a logistics environment.
- You are willing to work in 2 shifts.
- You have an EPT or forklift certificate, or you are willing to obtain one.
- You live in or near Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel or Valkenswaard.
